concerns.text: The plan references a “Dataset Strategy” that includes primary statistical datasets (UCI Wine Quality and UCI Adult Income) which are marked as *not available* and lack a clearly defined numeric outcome variable. Using such unverified or ill‑specified datasets undermines the core research question of quantifying how data cleaning impacts statistical inference, because the statistical tests require a well‑defined dependent variable. Replace these with verified public datasets that have an explicit outcome column and provide reachable URLs.

The statement “Scale/Scope: 2–3 public datasets (see Dataset Strategy)” is insufficient; the plan must explicitly name the concrete, verified datasets that will be used (including their HuggingFace repo IDs or URLs) and justify their suitability for t‑tests and regressions.
